units: <cite ref="Menachot 31b:2">Men. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>קרע … יִתְפּוֹר בשלש אל יתפור</he> if a rent (in the column of a scroll) goes through two lines, one may mend it; if through three, you dare not mend it (but must insert a new column).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 13:2">Sabb. XIII, 2</cite> <he>התּוֹפֵר … על מנת לִתְפּוֹר</he>, v. <cite ref="V00822"><he>תְּפִירָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 60b:10">Ib. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>תְּפָרוֹ מבפנים</he> if he fastened the leather shoe inside the sandal; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>תָּפוּר</he>; f. <cite ref="V00667"><he>תְּפוּרָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>תְּפוּרִים</he>, <he>תְּפוּרִין</he>, <he>תְּפוּרוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 5:1">Tosef. Toh. V, 1</cite> <he>נפל למים ת׳ טמא</he> if it (spittle) fell into water, if it remains joined (cohesive), it is clean, opp. <cite ref="M00857"><he>נמחה</he></cite> dissolved. Sabb. l. c.; <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:10">Bets. I, 10</cite> <he>כלים בין ת׳ ובין שאינן ת׳</he> garments when sewed or unsewed.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:10">Ib.</cite> <he>מנעל שאינו ת׳</he> a shoe the sole of which is not sewed on (though temporarily fastened with pegs); a. fr.

Kel. XX, 6 משיִתָּפֵר Var. (ed. משיִתָּבֵר) when the material for the curtain is sewed up; [Maim. reads משישבר = משישפר, expl. ‘when he has given it its due length and width by sewing’; for dialectic interchange of ב and פ see בָּקַר a. פָּקַר Hif., and הֶבְקֵר a. הֶפְקֵר].
